set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 9.

Problem:
LocalSubmissionPlanner.prepareBlocking (local/LocalSubmissionPlanner.scala:47-53) derives attemptId from submissionKey alone and the attempt directory from attemptId. LogRef carries the epoch (:73-74) but the locator does not, so a resubmission under the same submission key writes stdout.log/stderr.log into the same directory and overwrites the prior attempt.

Logs are the one attempt artifact outside the epoch fence that RetrySafety, AttemptEpoch, and RemoteResultValidation.attach otherwise enforce everywhere.

Acceptance:
- The attempt directory or log file names include the attempt epoch.
- A prior attempt log remains readable after a resubmission at a higher epoch.
- Array log patterns still resolve correctly through ArrayElementBinding.
- A regression test submits twice at different epochs and asserts both logs survive with distinct contents.
set.title: P6f.36: Fence local attempt log paths by attempt epoch
